title: Steel grillage footings.
officialText:
Grillage footings of structural steel shapes shall be separated with approved steel spacers and be
entirely encased in concrete with at least 6 inches (152 mm) on the bottom and at least 4 inches (102 mm) at all other points. The
spaces between the shapes shall be completely filled with concrete or cement grout.
